question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

During an office tour to Mumbai, I **__chanced to meet__** an old friend.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ran into."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Ran into"** means to meet someone unexpectedly. (किसी से अप्रत्याशित रूप से मिलना)

 
 
• **Example**: *They **ran into**__ a new set of problems as soon as they thought everything was fixed. found.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about meeting an old friend, which fits with the meaning of "ran into".
 
• This option also makes sense grammatically in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sentence**: *During an office tour to Mumbai, I __**ran into**__ an old friend. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (ran down)** means to criticize or belittle someone. (किसी की आलोचना करना या उसका अपमान करना)
 
• **Option 3 (ran over) **means to hit someone or something with a vehicle. (किसी को या वस्तु को वाहन से मारना)
 
• **Option 4 (ran about) **means to move quickly or busily. (तेजी से या व्यस्तता से आगे बढ़ना)

31:Tbb5,
The correct answer is **"Wavering."**
